meta.name: muapi-cinema-director
meta.description: Direct high-fidelity cinematic video with AI — translates creative intent into technical cinematographic directives for Veo3, Kling, and Luma video models via muapi.ai

copy.tagline: 将创意转化为高质量AI视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速生成电影级AI视频
copy.tagline_en: Turn creative ideas into high-fidelity AI videos
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly generate cinematic AI videos

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能根据你的创意描述，自动生成专业的电影级视频拍摄指令，包括镜头类型、运镜、灯光等，并调用 Veo3、Kling、Luma 等 AI 视频模型生成视频。
howto.when: 当你描述一个视频创意（如“一个武士在暴风雪中”），并指定导演意图（如“史诗亮相”）时触发。

say.text: 帮我生成一个孤独武士在暴风雪中的史诗亮相镜头。
say.note: Claude 会扩展为专业拍摄指令并调用视频模型。

say.text: 用 Kling 模型生成一个紧张不安的追逐场景。
say.note: Claude 会使用荷兰角、手持抖动等手法。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude can translate your creative intent into professional cinematic video directives (shot type, camera movement, lighting) and call Veo3, Kling, or Luma video models to generate the video.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you describe a video idea (e.g., 'a lone samurai in a blizzard') and specify a director's intent (e.g., 'epic reveal').

say_en.text: Generate an epic reveal shot of a lone samurai in a blizzard.
say_en.note: Claude expands it into technical directives and calls the video model.

say_en.text: Create a tense chase scene using Kling model.
say_en.note: Claude applies Dutch angle, handheld shake, etc.
